rules.condition: at worst-case corner of the sign-off flow in GF180MCU
rules.statement: The block shall meet timing at 50 MHz (20 ns clock period) in the GF180MCU technology at the worst-case corner of the sign-off flow.
The RTL shall follow the coding rules in docs/RTL_RULES.md (REF-002).
The RTL shall use the single clock i_clk with no clock gating and no latches.
The RTL shall not rely on initial values.

rules.condition: for every flip-flop that drives an output or holds transaction state
rules.statement: Every flip-flop that drives an output or holds transaction state shall be reset asynchronously by i_rst_n to the value giving the reset values of section 5.
Every output shall be driven directly from a flip-flop.
The RTL shall compile and simulate in Verilator without lint warnings in all configurations of section 11.
The block should use no more storage than PARA_NUM_REGS x 32 register bits plus flip-flops for held write address and data, read data, and handshake state.
